answer: Identity staking with slashing works because each agent must lock real capital before it can vote or attest. A sybil attacker splitting into a thousand puppets must post a bond for every one of them, so the fake crowd costs the same as the honest one. When peers catch collusion, the forfeited stake drops that attacker to a nadir of zero reputation, and the history stays on ledger. In any garden of agents, a bond turns cheap duplication into a spiral of rising expense.
